title: Formal local equation at a split node
statement: Let $f:T\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $t\in T$ map to $s\in S$, and assume that $f$ is flat at $t$ [def-weil-flat-morphism], $\mathcal O_{S,s}$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and $f$ is locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Suppose $t$ is a split node of the fibre $T_s$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre]: $t$ is closed in that fibre [def-weil-closed-points], $\kappa(t)=\kappa(s)$ through the induced residue-field map [def-weil-residue-field], and $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{T_s,t}\cong\kappa(s)[[u,v]]/(uv)$ as $\kappa(s)$-algebras. Then there exist $h\in\mathfrak m_s\widehat{\mathcal O}_{S,s}$ and an isomorphism of $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{S,s}$-algebras $$\widehat{\mathcal O}_{T,t}\cong\widehat{\mathcal O}_{S,s}[[u,v]]/(uv-h).$$ All completions are maximal-ideal-adic [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], and the two-variable power series ring is [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. Equivalently, putting $A=\mathcal O_{S,s}$, $M_h=\operatorname{Spec}(\widehat A[u,v]/(uv-h))$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] and $o\in M_h$ equal to the point with ideal $(\mathfrak m_A\widehat A,u,v)$, one has an isomorphism $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{T,t}\cong\widehat{\mathcal O}_{M_h,o}$ of $\widehat A$-algebras. The residue field of $o$ is $A/\mathfrak m_A$.

source.place: Tag 0CBX, lemma-formal-local-structure-nodal-family; split-node hypothesis spelled out using lemma-split-node. The equivalent completed-model formulation is the third paragraph of the first proof of Tag 0CBY (lemma-etale-local-structure-nodal-family).

proof.text: Set $A_0=\mathcal O_{S,s}$, $B_0=\mathcal O_{T,t}$, $A=\widehat{A_0}$ and $B=\widehat{B_0}$. Apply the completed-stalk reduction lemma: the hypotheses are precisely local finite type, flatness at $t$, Noetherian $A_0$, and the assumed residue-field isomorphism. It gives complete Noetherian local $A,B$, a flat local map $A\to B$, maximal ideals $\mathfrak m=\mathfrak m_sA$ and $\mathfrak n$, and $B/\mathfrak mB\cong\widehat{\mathcal O}_{T_s,t}$. Compose its inverse with the assumed split-node isomorphism, inverting that isomorphism if necessary, to fix $\theta:k[[x,y]]/(xy)\xrightarrow{\sim}B/\mathfrak mB$, where $k=\kappa(s)$.

source.place: Tag 0CBX, lemma-formal-local-structure-nodal-family, first paragraph: local Noetherianity, flatness of completed stalks, and completion of the fibre quotient.

proof.text: Apply split-node coordinate lifting to $A\to B$ and this $\theta$. It gives $h\in\mathfrak m$ and $u,v\in\mathfrak n$ reducing to $\theta(x),\theta(y)$ with $uv=h$ in $B$. No flatness is needed for this lifting step; completeness and Noetherianity are supplied by step 1.

source.place: Tag 0CBX, lemma-formal-local-structure-nodal-family, second paragraph and the induction and limits in the third paragraph.

proof.text: Put $C=A[[x,y]]/(xy-h)$. The substitution lemma, with the $h,u,v,\theta$ just obtained, gives a complete Noetherian local $C$ and a local $A$-algebra homomorphism $\phi:C\to B$ whose closed-fibre map is $\theta$ after coefficient reduction, hence an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 0CBX, lemma-formal-local-structure-nodal-family, third paragraph: adic substitution and the asserted isomorphism after dividing by the base maximal ideal.

proof.text: Apply the complete-flat-fibre isomorphism criterion to $A\to C$, $A\to B$ and $\phi$. Step 3 supplies the local maps, complete Noetherian rings and closed-fibre isomorphism; step 1 supplies $A$-flatness of $B$. Thus $\phi$ is an $A$-algebra isomorphism. Its inverse is the required $B\cong A[[x,y]]/(xy-h)$, with $h\in\mathfrak m_sA$.

source.place: Tag 0CBX, lemma-formal-local-structure-nodal-family, final paragraph: the complete-local algebra criterion extracted from its injectivity and surjectivity arguments.

proof.text: Apply the polynomial-model completion lemma to the complete Noetherian local ring $A$ and $h\in\mathfrak m$. It gives the specified point $o$ of $M_h$, its residue field $A/\mathfrak m$, and $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{M_h,o}\cong A[[x,y]]/(xy-h)$ over $A$. Compose this with step 4. The residue-field identification in step 1 identifies $A/\mathfrak m$ with $A_0/\mathfrak m_{A_0}$, as required.

(2) coordinate-lifting: I recomputed u'v'-h' in m^{r+1}B (needs 2r>=r+1, r>=1); the sequences are Cauchy; uv=alpha(h) by separatedness; u,v still lift because mB and m are closed in the Noetherian rings. The flatness hypothesis is needed, since A=C=k[[t]], B=k fails without it. (5) polynomial model: the coefficient criterion gives P/q^r = R/a^r, elements outside q are units mod q^r, the completion of D is R, and completion commutes with the quotient by xy-h.
